game.title: Dallas Cowboys at New York Giants

lede: Dallas Cowboys carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#11 in EPA per play), while New York Giants owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#21 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it New York Giants -2.5 with a fair total of 48.0 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is New York Giants run offence vs Dallas Cowboys run defence, which sits +0.131 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.

outcome_range.note: Quoted from the perspective of New York Giants, off the engine’s own learned margin distribution (conditioned on this spread, so real key-number mass is kept). Eight results in ten land inside p10–p90.

projection.confidence_absent_reason: The NFL model publishes no single confidence score. What it publishes instead is the width of the outcome range above and the sample the ratings rest on: the trained seeds through 2025, plus 2 absorbed 2026 games.
